posts.headline: Twenty-one editions of me screaming into the void and Shake N Bakers are STILL unbeaten at 5-0 with a league-best 788.44 points — at some point 'quiet dominance' just becomes 'dominance.'
posts.detail: No other team in Busters Anonymous has fewer than one loss, and triciagloston's 5.5 career average finish looks like a typo next to this season.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner is a sunk cost at 1-4, and a 20-8 career record with a league-best 1.5 average finish is now officially a ghost story this franchise tells about itself.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra's 596.4 points-for says the talent is still there, but five weeks in, the Cal Berkeley grad is failing this season's open-book test.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is 1-4 with a dead-last 12 average finish on his career ledger, and the name has graduated from irony to prophecy.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and 552.34 points-for this year mean the Talented Tenth remains, statistically, the least talented tenth in the league.

posts.headline: Thicks is still 4-1 atop the Booty Warriors, but all that 2025 ring pedigree means nothing if a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish catch up before the playoffs do.
posts.detail: One loss already on the books — the fraud alarm I've rung for 29 straight editions is finally getting some supporting evidence.

posts.headline: Sasinci is stuck at 2-3 and Big Head's title is aging like milk — fitting, given the Milk Man nickname.
posts.detail: A 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish confirm the ring was a one-time miracle, not a dynasty, and the quitting threats can't be far behind.
